name: The Doom of Caeranthil
desc:
The Doom of Caeranthil is a disaster event Boss that spawns in the Open Sea of the [Etrean Luminant](location:luminants) every 2 hours

-   05:00 | 07:00 | 09:00
-   11:00 | 13:00 | 15:00
-   17:00 | 19:00 | 21:00
-   23:00 | 01:00 | 03:00 UTC

It appears as a massive deep-blue serpent with two front fins and two pairs of yellow eyes. Its back is covered in tough scales that runs along its tail. Its name was earned when it destroyed the island of [Caeranthil](location:caeranthil) in the [Southern Luminant](location:luminants).

The Doom will swim across the seas of the [Etrean Luminant](location:luminants) in a specific pattern: it will begin near the Sea Highway gate to the south of [Erisia](location:erisia), go to the east of Erisia, go to [Etris Docks](location:etris_docks), go to Erisia's entrance and finally, [Vigil Docks](location:isle_of_vigils).

Once the Doom is defeated, a purple orb will soar towards all the players who dealt damage. Once the orb arrives at the player, Murmur: Ardour will be granted to those with no Murmur, a chest with loot will also spawn at the player's location, and the player will be granted a small amount of [Etrea](faction:etrea) reputation.

It can be damaged by cannons, if you do not want to attack him in close combat.
additional_info:
-   When it was first teased, it was known to the devs and community as the "World Serpent."
-   Given its drops, design and the Murmur: Ardour orb, it can be reasonably assumed that this creature is somehow related to the Dread Serpent. possibly a stronger variant or mutation.
-   The player must defeat this boss when it isn't firing it's Luminant Beam at Etris Docks to obtain the fist style "Fang and Coil" from [Vesque](entity:vesque).
-   It is internally referred to as ".kaijuu".
-   The Doom of Caeranthil's design is inspired from this image on DeviantArt, drawn by Elden Ardiente
